entries.f: The Egyptian Theatre: the 5-player dungeon, levels 8-12. Bosses in order: Brood Keeper, Hive Warden, Spitter Matriarch, The Egyptian Hive Mother. Brood Keeper: break the eggs before they hatch. Hive Warden charges. Spitter Matriarch leaves acid pools, do not stand in them and use the pillars to block her spit. The Hive Mother calls waves of adds and an egg sac heals her: kill the sac. Bosses drop blue gear, rolled need or greed. Sid Grauman gives the quest for it at level 8.
entries.loc: The door is on Hollywood Boulevard between Highland and Vine, on the south side.
entries.v: The Egyptian Theatre is the dungeon, for around level 8+, needs a group

entries.f: Mounts need level 40 and $80 (the fast ones at 60 cost far more): horses, an Indian Scout motorcycle, a Ford Model A. You cannot get one in this build because the zone only goes to level 12; the few riders around are players far ahead of everyone.
entries.v: mounts are for much higher levels and cost a lot

entries.f: Talents start at level 10: one point per level, three trees per class, a new tier every 5 points in a tree. Press N. Respec at your trainer for a fee that grows each time.
entries.v: talents unlock around level 10

entries.f: When you die you release your spirit and run back to your corpse as a ghost, or resurrect at an aid station with sickness (-25% stats for a while). Gear loses durability; repair at a vendor with the repair role.
entries.v: when you die you run back to your body

entries.f: Sitting at the inn (the Roosevelt) or logging out there builds rested XP, which doubles kill XP until it runs out.
entries.v: resting at the inn gives some kind of XP bonus

entries.f: Professions: Salvaging (learn from Ike Brandt at Hollywood & Vine; scrap nodes around the zone) and Gunsmithing (Earl Tanner at Hollywood & Highland; makes ammunition and guns from salvage). Press K.
entries.v: there are a couple of crafting professions

entries.f: The auction house is in the Taft Building at Hollywood & Vine (Cornelius Vane, Miss Opal Reed). List from your bags for 1, 4 or 12 hours with a deposit; other players bid, buy out and undercut. Sales and returns arrive by mail.
entries.v: you can sell things to other players at the auction house

entries.f: Right-click a player or type /invite <name> to group (up to five). Kill credit and quest kills are shared; loot from bosses is rolled need or greed. /leave to drop the group. The LFG channel (/4) is where people look for groups.
entries.v: you can invite people to a party

entries.f: Type /duel <name> outside the hubs. Nobody dies: the loser stops at 1 health; walking 40 m away forfeits. Fight night outside the Roosevelt ends with the champion challenging players for a purse.
entries.v: you can duel people outside town

entries.f: Chat: /s say, /y yell, /1 general, /2 trade, /4 lfg, /p party, /g guild, /w <name> whisper, /r reply, /who. Emotes: /dance /wave /bow /cheer /laugh /silly /flirt /train /chicken /cry /point /shrug /sit.
entries.v: there are slash commands for chat and emotes, try /help

entries.f: Picture night: about every 45 minutes a real pre-1930 film shows at Grauman's Chinese; sit and watch for 45 seconds to get +10% kill XP for half an hour.
entries.v: they show old films at the Chinese theatre sometimes and you get a buff

entries.f: Hive surge: every 30-50 minutes the bugs attack a hub in waves for ten minutes. Three or more kills earns a reward; if the hub is overrun its merchants close for 15 minutes.
entries.v: sometimes a swarm of bugs attacks the town

entries.f: Money is dollars and cents. Early income: sell grey junk to vendors, greens on the auction house, do quests. Repairs and abilities cost money, so do not buy vendor gear early.
entries.v: money is dollars and cents, quests give some

entries.f: Hollywoodland is a jam entry: an Unreal Engine 5 game running in the browser (WebAssembly and WebGPU), single-player with simulated players, one built zone (Hollywood Boulevard, levels 1-12) and one dungeon; the other twelve zones on the map are a facade. Saves live in the browser.
entries.v: it is an Unreal game that runs in the browser, made for the jam

entries.f: Levels 1-6 take roughly 40 minutes: do Sid Grauman's quest chain in the forecourt first, train at your class trainer every 2 levels, group up for the faster kills. The zone runs out of quests around level 12.
entries.v: do the quests from the guy at the start to level
